title: Brand & Marketing Executive
description:
Salary: £35,000 - £40,000 (negotiable Depending on experience)

Hours: Monday to Friday, typically 7:30am - 4:30pm (with a degree of flexibility)

Benefits
- Company-wide bonus scheme
- Lunch provided
- 23 days holiday plus bank holidays
- Auto-enrolment pension
- On-site parking
- Collaborative and close-knit team environment

Are you a creative marketer who enjoys bringing brands to life through exceptional presentations, marketing collateral and compelling customer communications?

This is an opportunity to join a growing, design-led SME business that works with premium brands around the world. Rather than focusing on strategy creation, your role will be to take an established marketing direction and execute it brilliantly across multiple channels, helping to ensure the business presents itself consistently, professionally and creatively at every customer touchpoint.

This role would suit a confident and commercially aware marketing professional who enjoys being hands-on, can work independently and takes pride in producing polished, high-quality marketing materials.

The Opportunity

As the key marketing professional within the business, you will work closely with commercial, project and design teams to create engaging communications that strengthen the company's brand position and support ongoing growth.

You'll be given autonomy to manage day-to-day marketing activity whilst collaborating with experienced colleagues across the business.

Key Responsibilities

Brand Communications & Marketing Materials
- Create professional customer presentations, sales decks and pitch materials
- Produce brochures, case studies and branded marketing collateral
- Ensure visual consistency across all customer-facing communications
- Develop engaging digital marketing assets

Content & Copywriting
- Create and edit compelling marketing copy
- Develop content for customer communications and email campaigns
- Produce engaging case studies and marketing literature
- Support ongoing website content updates and improvements

Internal Communications
- Create presentations and communication materials for internal initiatives
- Help ensure consistent brand messaging throughout the business
- Support the development of marketing resources used across departments

Marketing Operations
- Maintain marketing assets, literature and sample materials
- Coordinate marketing suppliers and external partners
- Manage marketing files, resources and documentation
- Handle inbound enquiries and direct opportunities to the appropriate teams

About You

We're keen to speak with candidates who have experience in a creative marketing, brand marketing or marketing communications position and can demonstrate a strong portfolio of work.

You will ideally possess:
- Experience in a marketing, brand or communications role
- Experience using Adobe Creative Cloud, including InDesign, Illustrator and Photoshop, or similar creative software
- Excellent copywriting and written communication skills
- A strong eye for detail and brand consistency
- The ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously
- A proactive, self-starting approach
- Commercial awareness and the confidence to work closely with customer-facing teams
- You are willing to be accountable for the results of your work

Most importantly, you'll be someone who enjoys taking ownership, working independently and turning ideas into high-quality marketing output that delivers real business impact.

Apply

If you're looking for a varied marketing role where you'll have the opportunity to influence how a growing business communicates with its customers, we'd love to hear from you.

Portfolio or examples of work, particularly presentation are welcomed as part of your application.

title: Marketing Analytics Manager
description:
Marketing Analytics Manager

This brand-new role will be pivotal in helping ARUK measure, understand and maximise the impact of marketing investment. Partnering with senior leaders across Marketing, Fundraising, Finance, Digital and Data, the Marketing Analytics Manager will lead the organisation's approach to marketing effectiveness, transforming audience, performance and financial data into actionable insight that informs strategic decision-making.

As a key specialist in marketing performance and insight, the role will support the ongoing development and embedding of ARUK's marketing effectiveness capability that enables teams to better understand the factors driving audience engagement, income growth and long-term supporter value. Through robust analysis, forecasting and performance frameworks, the role will evaluate investment effectiveness, identify opportunities and risks, and recommend how to optimise activity and support sustainable growth.

Working closely with the Senior Marketing Planning Manager and Head of Marketing Planning and Integration, the role will shape a clear and consistent approach to measuring performance across the organisation. By developing a forward-looking, insight-led culture, it will help ensure that evidence informs strategy, investment decisions and resource allocation, while influencing senior stakeholders to develop a more integrated understanding of performance and maximise the value and impact of ARUK's marketing activity.

Key Responsibilities:

Marketing Effectiveness & Performance Measurement

Support the development and delivery of ARUK's approach to marketing effectiveness measurement across channels and campaigns.

Manage and enhance marketing performance dashboards and reporting processes to support business decision-making.

Evaluate marketing investment performance and provide recommendations to improve ROI, effectiveness and resource allocation.

Develop performance frameworks, KPIs and forecasting approaches to support strategic decision-making.

Audience Insight & Learning

Translate audience, campaign and market insight into practical recommendations that improve campaign performance and audience engagement.

Support campaign teams with message testing and audience understanding.

Maintain key audience insight resources, such as YouGov Crunch, and manage their use across the organisation.

Identify emerging trends, risks and opportunities and communicate these proactively to senior stakeholders.

Support the Head of Marketing Planning and Integration and Senior Marketing Planning Manager in ensuring all marketing activity is rooted firmly in audience needs and motivations.

Data and Decision Support

Work with Product, CRM, Data and Finance teams to ensure accurate marketing reporting.

Identify opportunities to improve measurement and reporting processes and propose solutions where appropriate.

Provide evidence-based recommendations to support marketing investment, planning and optimisation decisions.

Identify gaps in measurement, insight and attribution, recommending and implementing improvements where required.

Champion and embed a test-and-learn approach across Strategic Marketing, ensuring learning informs future investment decisions.

Stakeholder Engagement & Upskilling

Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Marketing, Fundraising, Finance, Digital and Data teams.

Present complex analysis and performance insights clearly and compellingly, influencing strategic direction and investment decisions.

Act as a key point of contact for advice and guidance on marketing performance reporting and insight.

Support capability building across teams through coaching, training and knowledge sharing.

Strategic Influence & Leadership

Contribute to the ongoing development of marketing effectiveness processes and frameworks.

Identify opportunities to optimise marketing performance, measurement frameworks, processes and ways of working, developing evidence-based recommendations and influencing change via the Programme Manager of the Strategic Marketing & Communications Board.

Provide strategic challenge and constructive recommendations to improve marketing performance and supporter growth.

Influence organisational understanding of marketing impact through robust analysis, insight and forecasting.

Success Measures

Senior leaders use marketing performance insight to inform planning and investment decisions.

Marketing investment is increasingly directed towards the highest-performing audiences, channels and activities.

ARUK has a trusted, organisation-wide view of marketing effectiveness and ROI.

Marketing teams demonstrate a strong test-and-learn culture and use insight to optimise activity.

Marketing effectiveness becomes an established strategic capability across ARUK.

Knowledge, skills and experience needed:

Experience influencing senior stakeholders through evidence-based insights and recommendations, supporting strategic planning, investment and optimisation decisions.

Significant experience analysing marketing performance, audience and financial data across multiple channels to evaluate effectiveness and inform strategic decision-making.

Experience developing and owning performance measurement frameworks, KPIs, reporting and marketing effectiveness methodologies.

Demonstrable experience identifying opportunities for optimisation and influencing changes that improve marketing performance or return on investment.

Experience working with quantitative and qualitative audience insight and translating it into practical recommendations for campaign planning or proposition development.

Experience working with analytics, data or CRM teams to extract, clean and interpret data into marketing strategy.

Experience presenting insight and performance findings to senior stakeholders, with clear recommendations.

Ability to interpret complex datasets, identify patterns and turn evidence into actionable improvements.

Highly analytical, with strong critical-thinking and problem-solving skills.

Able to communicate complex information simply and compellingly.

Curious, evidence-led mindset-always seeking to understand what is working and why.

Confident influencing and constructively challenging senior stakeholders to improve marketing effectiveness and investment decisions.

High attention to detail and accuracy.

Ability to plan and manage multiple insight or analysis workstreams simultaneously.

Collaborative and proactive, with the ability to work closely with Fundraising, Digital, Insight, Brand, Communications and Data Teams.

Experience of tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Google Analytics, Looker Studio or equivalent.

Experience in marketing attributions and effective metholodogies, econometrics and/or test-and-learn-experimentation.

Understanding of brand KPIS, CPA/ROI analysis and funnel measurement.

Additional Information:

Ways of working:

As part of our Agile ways of working you will be required to work approximately 2 days a week from the office, which is subject to the requirements of the role and the business needs. Flexibility on where you work can be split between working from home and our office.

Roles that are classed as part of the Agile ways of working are not able to claim any costs for Mileage/Travel on Public Transport, Accommodation and/or Meals. This includes when attending the office for various meetings/events.

Our Office: Our office is at 3 Riverside, Granta Park, Great Abington, Cambridge, CB21 6 AD.

Salary: Circa £45,000 per annum, plus benefits.

Please download the Vacancy Pack on our website for more information.

The closing date for applications is the 1st November 2026, with interviews being arrange once shortlisting has been completed. Please indicate in your covering letter if you are unable to attend an interview on a certain date. We would encourage you to submit your application at the earliest opportunity, as on occasion we may have to bring forward the interview date and/or the closing date based on the needs of the business. Although a possibility, this will only happen in exceptional circumstances. Please indicate in your covering letter if you are unable to attend an interview on a certain date.

We value diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive culture where everyone can be themselves and reach their full potential. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, particularly from those in the global majority, those with disabilities, men and those from the LGBTQIA+ community. Any offer of employment is however subject to you having the right to work in the UK.

As part of our commitment to being an inclusive employer and ensuring fairness and consistency in our selection process, we will handle your CV and application with the utmost confidentiality. Should you require any adjustments at either the application or interview stage, please contact us via our website.

title: Marketing Executive - B2B Professional Services
description:
A stand-alone marketing role for a strong writer with ideas, where you'll run content, LinkedIn, campaigns and client events for a B2 B business that wants its marketing to show up in commercial results, not just engagement figures.

Marketing Executive - B2 B Professional Services

Peterborough
Hybrid: 4 days office-based / 1 day from home
30,000- 35,000 + benefits
Permanent, full time

The Opportunity

We're supporting a well-established B2 B professional services business with the appointment of a Marketing Executive.

This is a stand-alone role. You'll be the business's only dedicated marketer, working closely with senior leadership and owning marketing day to day.

It isn't a role for someone who needs a detailed brief for every post. The business wants someone who writes well, keeps the channels running, and comes forward with ideas for what to try next.

AI tools are already used across the business and set up around its brand. You won't be building them, but you will be expected to make the most of them.

Key Responsibilities

You'll own marketing across content, LinkedIn, email and events, working closely with the business's client-facing teams.
- Writing LinkedIn posts, case studies, blogs and website content.
- Running the company LinkedIn page and designing social graphics in Canva.
- Planning, building and sending campaigns to clients and contacts.
- Organising client events such as executive dinners and charity events, from venue to follow-up.
- Producing a monthly report on website traffic, LinkedIn engagement and campaign performance.
- Suggesting ideas for campaigns, content and events, drawing on the best of B2 B marketing.

What We're Looking For

You'll have 1-3 years of marketing experience, ideally in a B2 B or professional services environment such as consultancy, legal, accountancy, recruitment or financial services.

Strong writing is essential. You'll need to write a sharp LinkedIn post, a credible case study and a clean email campaign, and know which tone each one needs.

You'll be confident with LinkedIn, Canva and Mailchimp, comfortable using AI tools day to day, and able to pull basic reports from Google Analytics and LinkedIn page insights. Just as important, you'll be commercially minded, organised enough to run several campaigns and events at once, and comfortable dealing with senior people.

Why Join?

This is a chance to own a brand's marketing rather than sit in a corner of a large team. Your work will be visible to the leadership team and judged on what it does for the business.

The role offers hybrid working of four days office and one day from home, a package of 30,000- 35,000 plus benefits, and progression opportunities as the business scales.

If you're interested in learning more, we'd be happy to have a confidential conversation.

title: Senior Communications Officer
company: East Cambridgeshire District Council - Agency - Permanent
description:
Are you a creative communicator ready to celebrate local government achievements? East Cambridgeshire District Council has an exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity!

Location: Ely, Cambridgeshire, CB7 4 EE

Salary: £34,811 to £39,481 per annum

Job Type: Full time, 12 months fixed term contract

Hours: Hybrid working, with attendance at council offices three days per week

Closing Date: Sunday 25 October 2026

About Us:

East Cambridgeshire District Council is a local government organisation serving residents across the region. We are committed to delivering high-quality, customer-focused services and have recently achieved silver accreditation from the Investors in the Environment scheme, ranking 43rd nationally on the council climate scorecard. We prioritise environmental sustainability and responsible operations while supporting our communities.

Senior Communications Officer - The Role:

You will work as part of a busy, collaborative communications team to deliver clear, consistent and engaging communications to residents, employees, councillors and stakeholders. Your primary focus will be promoting the council's achievements, demonstrating the positive impact of its services and showing how the council improves local people's lives. You will manage multiple projects, create compelling content and build positive relationships across council services and external partners.

Senior Communications Officer - Key Responsibilities:
- Produce clear, accurate and engaging content for websites, newsletters, social media, briefing notes and press releases
- Develop and deliver communications and engagement plans that promote the council's priorities, services and achievements
- Create case studies, success stories and community outcomes for use across media and digital channels
- Manage and monitor social media channels, creating engaging content and responding to enquiries
- Create and maintain website content that is accurate, accessible and user-focused
- Support internal communications activities to keep employees informed about council priorities and organisational change
- Build effective relationships with colleagues, partners and media to gather information and promote council achievements
- Monitor media coverage and social media activity, identifying opportunities and reputational risks
- Evaluate campaign effectiveness and report on performance metrics
- Participate in the 24/7 communications on-call rota and work outside normal hours when necessary

Senior Communications Officer - You:
- Excellent communicator with strong written and verbal communication skills
- Highly organised with the ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
- Experienced in developing and delivering communications campaigns and engagement activities
- Skilled in creating engaging content across digital and traditional channels
- Confident in managing corporate social media platforms and online communities
- Passionate about storytelling and showcasing positive outcomes for residents and communities
- Collaborative team player equally confident working independently and using your own initiative

Benefits:
- The opportunity to help communicate and celebrate the council's achievements and contribution to local communities as local government transitions to new unitary authorities
- Potential to contribute to a major local government transformation programme
- Flexible and hybrid working arrangements
- Membership of the Local Government Pension Scheme
- Generous annual leave entitlement
- Learning and development opportunities
- A supportive and experienced communications team

Closing date for completed applications: Sunday 25 October 2026

The selection process will be: Wednesday 4 and Thursday 5 November 2026

To submit your CV for this exciting Senior Communications Officer opportunity, click Apply today!
